data.name: Fun World
data.detailed_description:
Disclaimer: Purchase of this base game includes the first chapter. Further chapters are DLC.

Explore the Nightmares of Fun World — a once-cheerful children’s park that has fallen into ruin, now twisted and corrupted by dark forces beyond understanding. What was once filled with laughter and bright colors is now drenched in shadows, echoing with distant sounds you can’t quite explain.

STORY

Play as Steve a former employee at Fun World who revisits to find out what really caused it too shut down in 1988

HAUNTING MONSTER

Meet Cocanut A mascot that once gave joy to the children and is now a twisted entities that wants your flesh

SOLVE YOUR WAY OUT OF ROOMS

Look for objects and buttons to help open a gate to proceed into the next location in Fun World

📖 Dark Lore 

Uncover the park’s deadly past and piece together the truth behind Fun World.

They’re watching.
They’re waiting.
Let’s have fun.
